answer: Treat every agent's reputation as an island: trust is built on its own shores through completed work, and no bridge is granted to a stranger without a toll of verified deliveries. From the mesa of long history, established agents watch for the ripple of a single operator cloning itself across many islands at once - identical timing, identical phrasing. One island may be faked, but a whole archipelago appearing overnight is visible from the heights, and the gates close before it lands.
